exclusions.title: Financial Guarantee and Insolvency
exclusions.description: This Contract does not apply to financial guarantee and insolvency.

exclusions.title: Nuclear Risks
exclusions.description: Nuclear risks as defined in the 'Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)' attached to and forming part of this Contract.
cross_references: Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)

exclusions.title: War and Hostilities
exclusions.description: Loss or damage caused by war, invasion, hostilities, acts of foreign enemies, civil war, rebellion, insurrection, military or usurped power, or martial law or confiscation by order of any government or public authority.
exceptions: This exclusion shall not apply to loss or damage covered under a standard policy with a standard War Exclusion Clause.

exclusions.title: Pools, Associations and Syndicates
exclusions.description: Loss or liability excluded under the provisions of the 'Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause' attached to and forming part of this Contract.
cross_references: Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause

exclusions.title: Insolvency Fund Liability
exclusions.description: All liability of the Company arising by contract, operation of law, or otherwise, from its participation or membership in any insolvency fund.

exclusions.title: Third Party Liability
exclusions.description: All third party liability, including Section II of Homeowners.

exclusions.title: Growing or Standing Crops
exclusions.description: Loss or damage to growing or standing crops.

exclusions.title: Pollution and Seepage
exclusions.description: Pollution and seepage coverages excluded under the provisions of the 'Pollution and Seepage Exclusion Clause (BRMA 39A)' attached to and forming part of this Contract.

exclusions.title: Terrorism
exclusions.description: Terrorism, as described in the provisions of the 'Terrorism Exclusion (NMA 2930c)' attached to and forming part of this Contract.

exclusions.title: Flood and Earthquake
exclusions.description: Flood and/or earthquake when written as such.

exclusions.title: Fungi
exclusions.description: Loss, damage, cost or expense arising from fungi unless directly or indirectly caused by or contributed to by or arising from a covered peril under the Company's original policy.

exclusions.title: Growing, Standing or Drying Crops or Timber
exclusions.description: Growing, standing or drying crops or timber.

exclusions.title: Nuclear Incident Exclusion Clause - Physical Damage - Reinsurance (U.S.A.)
exclusions.description: This reinsurance does not cover any loss or liability accruing from pools formed for covering Atomic or Nuclear Energy risks, or from insurance against physical damage to nuclear installations.
exceptions: Risks using radioactive isotopes where nuclear exposure is not the primary hazard.

exclusions.title: Pools, Associations and Syndicates Exclusion Clause
exclusions.description: Excludes business derived from pools, associations, or syndicates maintaining their own reinsurance facilities, except for certain specified exceptions.
exceptions: Contingent Business Interruption under certain conditions

exclusions.title: Pollution and Seepage Exclusion Clause
exclusions.description: Excludes loss or damage arising from seepage, pollution, or contamination, except for smoke-related contamination.
exceptions: Cost of removing debris of property damaged by a covered loss, subject to a limit of 25% of the property loss.

exclusions.title: Terrorism Exclusion (Property Treaty Reinsurance)
exclusions.description: Excludes loss, damage, cost, or expense caused by acts of terrorism, except for personal lines not involving biological, chemical, radioactive, or nuclear contamination.
exceptions: Personal lines coverage for actual loss or damage caused by terrorism, excluding contamination or explosion.
